name: Form Pressing
implementation_notes: REVISED 2026-08-24 (entity-catalog v12, replacing the original fixed 24-row design the user explicitly rejected as wasting screen space): Pressing Detail grid now renders whatever rows exist (0..24) loaded from pressingRecordRepo.getDraftWithDetails(), with Tambah baris/Hapus baris controls -- the exact same dynamic add-row/remove-row pattern as Threshing Detail (screen-041, just fixed) and Cages Tipped Time (screen-012), no longer a structural difference from those grids

Target Operasional reference table sourced from a STATIC constant (mobile/src/data/pressingOperationalTargets.ts, created under screen-038) rather than a synced local reference table -- unchanged by this revision, same judgment call already documented for Threshing (screen-041): building a sync mechanism for 7 rarely-changing rows was judged out of proportion; if Admin edits these values via web in the future, mobile needs an app update to reflect it

'Minimal 1 baris valid' (Time-Slot terpilih + minimal 1 kolom bacaan terisi) validated at FE + repo level (pressingRecordRepo.saveDraft() throws PressingDetailRequiredError) -- NOT enforced by the server model's PressingRecord::booted() saving guard, which only checks row EXISTENCE (now meaningfully true only once the user has added at least one row, since rows are no longer pre-created)

availableTimeSlotOptions() compares slots by their index in canonicalTimeSlots() rather than a raw hour number (since slots wrap starting at 07:00, not 0-23) -- the one structural difference from Cages Tipped Time's availableHourOptions(), otherwise the floor/exclusion logic is identical to Threshing's just-fixed version

Every FormField id in the grid is set explicitly (e.g. digester-temp-{index}) to avoid duplicate DOM ids across rows sharing the same label text -- FormField.vue's default id-from-label slug would otherwise collide
Time-Slot per row is now a SearchableSelect.vue instance (was a read-only label) -- mirrors FormThreshingView.vue exactly

REVISI (tech-spec v3, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak): FormPressingView menyimpan ke SQLite lokal tanpa memeriksa periode; satu-satunya panggilan server dari form ini adalah write-through syncAfterSave('pressing_record') → pushSavedRecordNow → POST /api/pressing-records bila Mills Setting immediate_sync_enabled aktif. Penolakannya (termasuk 422 PERIOD_CLOSED) sejak 2026-10-03 ditampilkan langsung di form (lihat catatan REVISI 2026-10-03); di sinkron manual screen-006 alasannya tampil per record di SyncResultDialog. Guard EnforcesPeriodLock::assertPeriodOpenForWrite('pressing', mill, date) di PressingRecordService::create() menilai periode saat request tiba (bukan saat dicatat). Form hanya membuka draft lokal; tidak ada jalur edit/PATCH record tersinkron dari mobile. Cakupan: backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan whitelist + 'ke-18 *RecordService memanggil guard pada create MAUPUN update'), backend/tests/Feature/Api/KelolaPeriodePelaporanTest.php ('menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED untuk data mobile yang menyusul, lalu menerimanya setelah periode dibuka kembali'), mobile/tests/syncService.spec.ts (gagal per record dengan reason dari server, galat generik), dan mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts.

REVISI (2026-10-03): penolakan write-through kini ditampilkan — writeThroughSync.syncAfterSave() mengembalikan {synced, rejection}; respons server 4xx (mis. 422 PERIOD_CLOSED) mengisi rejection dengan pesan server, sedangkan offline/5xx/fitur nonaktif tetap {synced:false, rejection:null} dan diam. onSimpan() FormPressingView menyimpan pesan itu ke writeThroughRejection, menampilkan ConfirmDialog satu tombol (cancel-label="") berjudul 'Tersimpan, tetapi ditolak server' dengan pesan server, dan baru bernavigasi ke monitor-pressing saat dialog ditutup (Mengerti atau klik overlay). Record tetap 'saved' di SQLite lokal, tidak ada rollback. Test: mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts ('reports the server message when the push is rejected with 422 PERIOD_CLOSED' + kasus diam); tidak ada test per-form untuk dialog ini di layar Pressing — pola identik dengan Threshing yang dicakup mobile/tests/FormThreshingView.spec.ts.

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) e2e spec (mobile/tests/e2e/form-pressing.spec.ts) was authored/revised for the dynamic grid but could not be executed in this sandboxed environment -- verified only by static review.
